resources.string: Shows a TIDAL Connect receiver reachable over Tailscale (e.g. TidaLuna DesktopConnectNative on a PC) in TIDAL\'s device list, also on mobile data, where Android does no mDNS.
The Tailscale IP or MagicDNS name of the PC running the receiver. Several PCs: separate with ;. If the receiver\'s Port setting is not 9000, add :port.
Waiting for the Xposed framework… Enable this module in Vector/LSPosed with TIDAL in its scope.
The Xposed framework is not reachable: enable this module in Vector/LSPosed, then reopen this screen.
Saved. Force-stop TIDAL and open it again.
✗ No receiver at %1$s (is Tailscale on, the plugin running, the port allowed in the PC\'s firewall?)
Works with TidaLuna\'s DesktopConnectNative 1.0.6 or newer. Tested with TIDAL Android 2.220.1.
